_meta.category: derived (ACS block-group and tract estimates allocated to zones through 2020 Census blocks; within-block-group uniformity is an assumption)

sources.acs: American Community Survey 5-year (ACS 2024 5-year, 2020–2024) via the Census Reporter API: B25044 tenure by vehicles available, B25008 population in occupied housing units, B11007 households with people 65+ by household size, B01001 sex by age (block groups); B18105 ambulatory difficulty, B18101 disability status (tracts). Cache: data/raw/census/acs-demand.json (tools/fetch-demand-acs.mjs).
sources.blocks: 2020 Census blocks POP100 and HU100 at interior points (TIGERweb Tracts_Blocks layer 12), data/raw/census/blocks-2020.json.
sources.zones: Genasys evacuation zones as merged in data/model/layers.json (tools/build-network.mjs).

facilities.category: sourced (public licensing and school records), aggregated by evacuation zone (derived)
facilities.note: Counts and licensed capacity, beds or enrollment by type and Genasys zone. No names or addresses are kept. unknown = facilities in the count whose capacity or enrollment is not known.

ccl.rule: STATUS 3 (licensed; every facility it shares with the CCL CSV of 2025-05-25 is LICENSED there). Capacity = licensed capacity.

cdph.rule: FAC_STATUS_TYPE_CODE OPEN; SNF = skilled nursing; ICF* and CLHF = intermediate care and congregate living; GACH and APH = hospitals. Beds = CAPACITY (licensed beds). A hospital listed twice at one address with 0 beds adds a facility and no beds.

publicSchools.rule: Active schools in the directory (district offices left out); enrollment = Census Day 2025-26 total (ReportingCategory TA). Adult education and preschool sites have no Census Day enrollment and count with enrollment unknown.

privateSchools.rule: NCES 2023-24 locations in the envelope; enrollment from the CDE 2025-26 affidavit file where the normalized name matches exactly (Berkeley, Albany, Oakland, West Contra Costa and Emery districts); otherwise counted with enrollment unknown. Schools in the CDE file that NCES does not locate are not counted.

empower.note: Medicare beneficiaries (Medicare fee-for-service and Medicare Advantage, per HHS emPOWER) who rely on electricity-dependent durable medical equipment, by ZIP. HHS publishes 11 for any count from 1 to 10 (suppression), so 11 means "1 to 11". Not by evacuation zone: ZIPs cross zone lines, and some ZIPs (94516 Canyon, 94563 Orinda, 94803 El Sobrante) lie mostly outside the model area.

_meta.method: See the header of tools/build-demand.mjs. Shares: zero-vehicle = households with no vehicle / households; personsPerHousehold = population in occupied housing units / households; alone65 = one-person households with a person 65+ / households; age75, age65 = share of population; ambulatory, disability = share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population 5+ (ambulatory) or all ages (disability), tract level. range = estimate ± 90% MOE. implied counts apply each share to popModeled.
_meta.fallbackRule: model rule: a zone without households in the 2020 blocks keeps the citywide values (2.37 persons per household, 0.0747 without a vehicle)
